results.title: Front batch 15's exit with both real signatures
results.how: The exit exactly as both watchtowers signed it, one block before it was really paid (tx 0x9705770b52cdb3448277915a778f1e0e6ba4c8ffddcb2ae4ae6d574416637933).

results.title: Front batch 18's exit with both real signatures
results.how: The exit exactly as both watchtowers signed it, one block before the relayer paid it (tx 0x6542b5f393cd4b37f349ef3b2e9edfe103d81b2f675d4ee48c0bd2f2de627c8f).

results.title: Attest the creator's real anchor at layer height 0
results.how: The anchor as the chain stores it. It is already on the contract's record, so the call succeeds and records nothing new.

results.title: One bit of a quorum signature changed
results.how: watchtower-2's real ML-DSA-87 signature with one bit of byte 100 flipped.

results.title: Signed by a key that is not a quorum member
results.how: A fresh ML-DSA-87 key, made for this run, signs the exact exit message in watchtower-2's place.

results.title: A classical signature instead of ML-DSA-87
results.how: A fresh secp256k1 key signs the exit message with ECDSA (65 bytes) in watchtower-2's place.

results.title: Only one member signs
results.how: watchtower-2's real signature alone; the vault needs both.

results.title: One member counted twice
results.how: watchtower-2's real signature given twice, as signers 0 and 0.

results.title: Signatures swapped between members
results.how: watchtower-3's real signature in watchtower-2's slot, and the other way round.

results.title: Amount raised
results.how: Both real signatures, with the amount raised from 0.1 QOR to 100 QOR.

results.title: Payout changed to the attacker
results.how: Both real signatures, with the attacker's address as the payout.

results.title: Another withdrawal
results.how: Both real signatures, claimed for withdrawal 5 instead of 4.

results.title: Another batch
results.how: Both real signatures, claimed for batch 19 instead of 18.

results.title: Deadline pushed back
results.how: Both real signatures, with the deadline a day later, past the time the batch could be final.

results.title: The same exit fronted again
results.how: Both real signatures, one block after batch 15's exit was paid.

results.title: The same exit fronted again
results.how: Both real signatures, one block after batch 18's exit was paid.

results.title: Fronted after its deadline
results.how: Both real signatures for batch 18's exit, at the run's head block.

results.title: Replayed at another vault
results.how: Both real signatures, sent to an exact copy of the vault (its own deploy-tx input: the same chain, rollup, quorum and LP) run in place at another address; nothing is deployed. Only the vault's address differs, and every exit message names it.
results.evidence: EVIDENCE 88, 89, 91; inbox entries 18 and 19; deploy tx (EVIDENCE 83)

results.title: Take the LP's liquidity without the LP's key
results.how: A fresh ML-DSA-87 key signs the vault's exact withdrawal message for 1 QOR to the attacker, at the vault's current nonce.

results.title: Call settle as someone other than the payout's exit address
results.how: The attacker calls settle for the real payout, sending no value. Only the caller check is exercised: settle lowers a debt only by the value sent, and the payout owed nothing once the vault was repaid (EVIDENCE 108).

results.title: A state root the creator never signed
results.how: The real anchor at layer height 0 with the top bit of its state root flipped.

results.title: A signature moved to another layer height
results.how: Heights 4 and 5 carry the same state root; height 4's real signature is presented for height 5.

results.title: Signed by a key that is not the creator's
results.how: A fresh ML-DSA-87 key signs the exact v2 anchor message for layer height 0.

results.title: A classical signature instead of ML-DSA-87
results.how: The ECDSA signature from the fresh secp256k1 key (65 bytes) in place of the anchor's signature.

results.title: Release the vault's QOR without the guardian's key
results.how: A fresh ML-DSA-87 key signs the vault's exact release message for 25 QOR to the attacker, at the vault's current nonce.

results.title: A classical signature instead of ML-DSA-87
results.how: The same release with the fresh secp256k1 key's ECDSA signature (65 bytes).
